prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic high-fashion editorial portrait of three original approved adult women against a raw concrete wall in an industrial studio.
prompt.main_subject: Three distinct original approved adult women with varied loose hairstyles: long dark waves, medium brown waves, and long natural red hair. They wear coordinated black structured fashion bodysuits with tailored coverage, bold supplied silver jewelry and nameplate pendants, and dramatic black knee-high boots with thick faux-fur texture. Expressions are serious, confident, and direct.
composition_elements: Two women stand upright with assertive poses while one sits or crouches in the foreground, forming a dynamic triangular composition.
Raw concrete wall and industrial floor with muted gray tones and subtle real-world texture.
Preserve supplied jewelry shapes and nameplate typography, black wardrobe, boot texture, distinct faces, and three-person count.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional studio light with controlled side shadow, subtle highlights on jewelry and fabric, natural contact shadows, and moody cinematic contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 group portrait, 50mm lens at f/5.6, sharp faces and wardrobe detail, realistic skin pores, slight analog grain, restrained black-gray palette, no added text or watermark.
